red__fitscube_intensitycorr.pro

includes main-level program

Routines

top source red::fitscube_intensitycorr

SST pipeline

red::fitscube_intensitycorr, filename, fitpref_time=fitpref_time [, intensitycorrmethod=string or boolean], notimecheck=notimecheck

Correct a fitscube for intensity variation between observation time and prefilter calibration time.

Parameters

filename in type=string

The name of the file containing the fitscube.

Keywords

fitpref_time
intensitycorrmethod in optional type=string or boolean

One of 'old' (for correction based on comparing the current scan with the prefilter calibration data), or 'fit' (for correction based on comparing intensity from fit_wb_diskcenter, evaluated at the current time and at the time of the prefilter calibration). Boolean value TRUE is equivalent to 'fit'. FALSE and 'none' (really any string value that is not 'fit' or 'old') results in no correction. (The values "fit_wb" and "fit_nb" are also permitted, the former useful to select the WB fit when a NB fit is present.)

notimecheck
